Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing fees to conduct special inspections of poultry or poultry facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing fees to fund inspections for theprotection of animal health; and adding a new section to chapter 16.36RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director may adopt rules establishing fees for conductingspecial inspections of poultry or poultry facilities that the directormay provide at the request of the poultry owner or individual managingsuch animals. (2) The fees shall, as closely as practical, cover the cost of theservice provided. (3) Persons requesting facility approval or inspections under thissection are responsible for payment of fees for the requested services.All fees collected under this section shall be deposited in an accountin the agricultural local fund and used to carry out the purposes ofthis chapter.
